items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And the other drummer Lewis Nash, he’s the number one choice. Everybody is calling him...

ctx.x: And the other drummer Lewis Nash, he’s the number one choice. Everybody is calling him, so you have to call him like a year in advance or something. The only thing I was worried about was Curtis, but I hear that he’s doing very well, so we have a couple rehearsals next week and then go on over there.
Oh, so you’ll rehearse here and then go over?
